name: kms:Decrypt on * narrowed by a kms:ViaService condition (decryption capability acknowledged, lower exploitability)
note: The decrypt grant is confined to requests made through one AWS service. The KMS-DECRYPT finding should stand but reflect reduced exploitability.
rationale: The kms:ViaService condition key restricts kms:Decrypt to requests that arrive through the named service endpoint (here S3 in us-east-1); the principal cannot call Decrypt directly with arbitrary ciphertext. The decryption capability is real but gated, so KMS-DECRYPT must remain with reduced path-exploitability rather than a maximal rating. Per IAM-103/2.1, kms:Decrypt is a distinct decryption capability and must NOT be lumped with Secrets Manager reads (DATA-EXFIL): it decrypts ciphertext for usable keys, it does not enumerate or retrieve secret material. Ref: AWS docs, condition key kms:ViaService; KMS Decrypt semantics.
